decks.title: The Catapult Engineering Challenge
namedTheoryCoverage: A system is defined by relationships
Feedback turns testing into a design loop
Constraints are boundaries; criteria judge success

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: A system is defined by relationships
theoryVisuals.caption: A mechanism works because its parts interact, not because each part exists.
theoryVisuals.notice: Trace how changing the pivot, arm or energy-store position could affect the other parts.
theoryVisuals.alt: Unassembled timber lever pieces, pivot blocks and an elastic loop arranged as an abstract mechanism study on a workshop bench.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Abstract unassembled timber blocks, dowel pivot, separate lever strip and relaxed elastic loop; no complete Catapult or buildable geometry.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 01, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Feedback turns testing into a design loop
theoryVisuals.caption: An observed output becomes feedback only when it guides the next decision.
theoryVisuals.notice: Look for the observation that would make a designer keep, question or change one feature.
theoryVisuals.alt: Partial lever teaching model beside blank observation and revision cards arranged as a feedback example.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Partial nonfunctional lever model beside blank observation and revision cards; no results, dimensions or complete design.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 01, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Constraints are boundaries; criteria judge success
theoryVisuals.caption: Constraints set the boundary; criteria need evidence.
theoryVisuals.notice: Separate what the design must work within from what must be observed to judge success.
theoryVisuals.alt: Pine, string, nails and elastic material contained in a tray beside a blank quality-check card and measuring tools at rest.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Confirmed material categories in one tray beside a separate blank quality card and tools at rest; no project form or stock cross-section.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 01, matching theory section only.

decks.title: Workshop Readiness, Tools and Materials
namedTheoryCoverage: Risk depends on the situation
Choose tools by the function required
Pine and elastic materials do not behave identically

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: Risk depends on the situation
theoryVisuals.caption: Risk depends on the task, condition, people and controls—not the object alone.
theoryVisuals.notice: Identify the hazard, then ask what context and teacher-approved control change the decision.
theoryVisuals.alt: Inactive workshop tool, material sample, clear workspace marker and blank teacher-check card arranged for a safety briefing.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Unplugged palm sander safely supported on a mat, material sample, workspace boundary and blank teacher card; no tool use or PPE claim.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 02, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Choose tools by the function required
theoryVisuals.caption: Start with the function, then choose the approved process and check its result.
theoryVisuals.notice: Match the required job to material, access and evidence—not to the most powerful tool.
theoryVisuals.alt: Measuring, holding, material-changing and joining tool categories arranged safely at rest beside a pine sample.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Representative measuring, holding, material-changing and joining tool categories safely at rest around one pine specimen.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 02, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Pine and elastic materials do not behave identically
theoryVisuals.caption: Material names are not enough; inspect grain, condition, deformation and recovery.
theoryVisuals.notice: Compare natural variation in pine with temporary and permanent change in an elastic material.
theoryVisuals.alt: Close-up of pine samples with different grain features beside relaxed and permanently misshapen elastic loops.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Macro comparison of varied pine grain and knots beside relaxed and permanently misshapen elastic loops, all at rest.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 02, matching theory section only.

decks.title: Siege Engines, Levers and the Woomera
namedTheoryCoverage: Similar outputs can begin with different energy stores
A moment combines force and distance
Jared Thomas explains lever action in context

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: Similar outputs can begin with different energy stores
theoryVisuals.caption: Different systems can seek similar movement while storing energy in different ways.
theoryVisuals.notice: Identify where torsional and gravitational potential energy would be stored; these are mechanism models, not historical reconstructions.
theoryVisuals.alt: Two museum-style mechanism models: a twisted-cord axle and a raised-weight lever, both inactive and without projectiles.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Two neutral museum-style mechanism models, twisted-cord axle and securely supported raised-weight lever; inactive, no projectile or historical reconstruction.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 03, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: A moment combines force and distance
theoryVisuals.caption: A moment depends on force and perpendicular distance from the pivot.
theoryVisuals.notice: Compare the two arm lengths and predict how moving the effort point changes the trade-off.
theoryVisuals.alt: Top-down lever model with a central pivot and neutral loads placed at unequal distances.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Top-down neutral ruler lever on a simple pivot with equal neutral loads at unequal distances; no labels, values or result.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 03, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Jared Thomas explains lever action in context
theoryVisuals.caption: Museum display photograph; forms vary and the objects are not presented as one universal account.
theoryVisuals.notice: Begin with Jared Thomas’s attributed explanation; use the photograph only to notice that forms vary.
theoryVisuals.alt: Several spear-throwers displayed in a museum case; cultural provenance is not provided on the image source.
theoryVisuals.source: Woomeras (spear-throwers) at American Museum of Natural History, Vicpeters, 14 May 2025, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. File-format conversion to PNG only; no crop. Object provenance is not supplied; this display does not represent all Countries or Jared Thomas’s Country.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 03, matching theory section only.

decks.title: Force, Motion, Energy and Prototypes
namedTheoryCoverage: Energy transfers through useful and unwanted pathways
Newton’s laws describe different parts of one event
A prototype earns value through a clear question

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: Energy transfers through useful and unwanted pathways
theoryVisuals.caption: Stored elastic energy can become intended motion and also spread through sound, vibration and heat.
theoryVisuals.notice: Find the intended moving relationship and one pathway where energy could spread elsewhere.
theoryVisuals.alt: Contained elastic teaching mechanism at rest with a lightly deformed elastic element and lever against a padded stop.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Guarded macro of an incomplete elastic relationship lightly deformed against a padded stop; inactive and without projectile or release.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 04, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Newton’s laws describe different parts of one event
theoryVisuals.caption: Newton’s laws answer different questions about motion and interactions.
theoryVisuals.notice: Separate the object whose motion changes from the two objects in a force pair.
theoryVisuals.alt: Three-panel tabletop physics scene showing a stationary trolley, a trolley connected to a spring pull and two trolleys in contact.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Three photographic classroom trolley observations: rest, spring pull and contact between two trolleys; no numbers, procedure or result.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 04, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: A prototype earns value through a clear question
theoryVisuals.caption: A fair comparison changes one feature and holds important conditions steady.
theoryVisuals.notice: Find the one changed feature and the details that must remain consistent.
theoryVisuals.alt: Two nonfunctional cardboard lever prototypes at rest with one visible design difference and blank observation cards.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Paired nonfunctional cardboard lever prototypes identical except for one visible relationship, with blank observation cards and no test result.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 04, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Strong selection begins with genuinely different ideas
theoryVisuals.caption: Selection begins with genuinely different system ideas, then uses evidence and trade-offs.
theoryVisuals.notice: Look for differences in component relationships—not colour or decoration.

decks.title: Producing the Base and Frame
namedTheoryCoverage: Dependencies determine a sensible sequence
Structures carry forces along load paths
Quality evidence should show relationships between parts

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: Dependencies determine a sensible sequence
theoryVisuals.caption: A checkpoint protects the next dependent stage from an earlier mismatch.
theoryVisuals.notice: Identify what must be checked before the set-aside components can sensibly be added.
theoryVisuals.alt: Partial generic timber frame corner beside a square while later components remain set aside.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Loose partial timber corner relationship checked with a square while later components remain set aside; no joinery or sequence.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 06, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Structures carry forces along load paths
theoryVisuals.caption: Loads travel through connected members and joints towards supports.
theoryVisuals.notice: Follow where the applied load could travel and locate an interface that might interrupt the path.
theoryVisuals.alt: Small triangular timber teaching frame supporting a light neutral block above two broad base supports.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Abstract triangular timber teaching frame supporting a light neutral block above broad supports; no Catapult geometry or strength claim.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 06, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Quality evidence should show relationships between parts
theoryVisuals.caption: Quality evidence records the relationship checked, the observation and the reason for any adjustment.
theoryVisuals.notice: Look for a clear subject and the feature that the evidence would need to explain.
theoryVisuals.alt: Partial generic timber frame beside a square, camera and blank caption card arranged as a quality-evidence example.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Partial generic frame, square, unmarked camera and blank evidence card; no drilled holes, controls, student work or pass claim.

decks.title: Components, Assembly and Quality
namedTheoryCoverage: Component functions form an interaction chain
Alignment, fit and friction shape quality
One controlled adjustment protects cause and effect

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: Component functions form an interaction chain
theoryVisuals.caption: Changing one interface can alter alignment, clearance, friction and forces elsewhere.
theoryVisuals.notice: Trace the chain from support to pivot to motion without treating the close-up as a build instruction.
theoryVisuals.alt: Close-up of an incomplete axle-and-lever teaching model showing supports, a dowel pivot and a separate elastic loop.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Tight macro of an incomplete support, dowel and short lever relationship with a separate elastic loop; cropped, inactive and non-prescriptive.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 07, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Alignment, fit and friction shape quality
theoryVisuals.caption: Alignment and fit shape movement; friction may be useful or unwanted depending on function.
theoryVisuals.notice: Compare centrelines, clearance and contact; do not judge quality from neat appearance alone.
theoryVisuals.alt: Paired close-ups of abstract timber supports, one aligned around a dowel and one visibly misaligned.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Split photographic comparison of two abstract paired-support models, one aligned and one misaligned; no tolerances or adjustment method.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 07, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.caption: One controlled adjustment preserves cause-and-effect evidence.
theoryVisuals.notice: Find the single visible change and identify what should be rechecked before making another.

decks.title: Testing, Data and Redesign
namedTheoryCoverage: A testable question separates the variables
Mean and range answer different questions
Redesign is a claim tested against evidence

visual.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026, conceptual only.

theoryVisuals.section: A testable question separates the variables
theoryVisuals.caption: A testable question names one change, one response and the conditions held steady.
theoryVisuals.notice: Identify the feature intended to change and the details that must remain controlled.
theoryVisuals.alt: Unloaded lever teaching rig with one interchangeable feature and fixed blank reference markers.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Unloaded nonfunctional lever teaching rig with one interchangeable feature and fixed blank reference markers; no projectile or procedure.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 08, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Mean and range answer different questions
theoryVisuals.caption: Repeated trials can reveal pattern and variation; one trial is only an event.
theoryVisuals.notice: Compare the repeated setup and look for evidence that the important conditions stayed consistent.
theoryVisuals.alt: Three identical unloaded lever-test setups viewed from the same angle beside blank record cards.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Three identical unloaded observation setups from the same angle with blank cards; no numbers, results, anomalies or performance claim.
theoryVisuals.reuse: Website Module 08, matching theory section only.

theoryVisuals.section: Redesign is a claim tested against evidence
theoryVisuals.caption: A redesign should target a likely cause and then be tested against the same measure.
theoryVisuals.notice: Find the single changed feature and predict which evidence would confirm or challenge the claim.
theoryVisuals.alt: Before-and-after partial timber interface models with one visible relationship changed and blank evidence cards.
theoryVisuals.source: OpenAI image generation for this course, 24 Aug 2026; conceptual teaching still life; final prompt: Sparse before-and-after partial interfaces with one visible relationship changed and blank evidence cards; no complete design or result.
